documents.title: Backup Policy
documents.text:
# Backup Policy

## Schedule
Full backups run daily at 02:00 UTC and take approximately forty minutes.
Incremental backups run every four hours.

## Retention and Encryption
Backups are retained for 30 days, after which they are purged automatically.
All backup archives are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and stored in a separate region.

## Restore Testing
A restore rehearsal is performed on the first Monday of each quarter.

documents.title: API Gateway Spec
documents.text:
# API Gateway Spec

## Rate Limiting
Each client is limited to 100 requests per second with a burst allowance of 200.
Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

## Authentication
Clients authenticate with a JWT bearer token. Tokens expire after 15 minutes and must be refreshed.

## Retries
Transient upstream failures are retried with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts.

documents.title: Compensation Committee
documents.text:
# Compensation Committee

## Bonus Pool
The executive bonus pool for Q4 is capped at 15 percent of operating profit.

## Vesting
Equity grants vest over four years with a one year cliff.
